ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) dominant in the central and distal lobe regions, contrasted by low-intensity streaks (black/dark grey) concentrated near the median notch and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light grey/white base occupies approximately 70% of the visible surface. Darker, irregular contiguous streaks and mottling radiate from the median notch area towards the outer lobe regions. Darker pigmentation is more densely clustered along the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 20% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; pixel amplitude of variations increases towards the distal tips, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, yellowish-white clusters of high pixel intensity at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the light-pigmented surfaces, particularly prominent on the inner portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcareous colonization at both lobe tips and extensive linear rake mark scarring across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark circular ring-like formation is visible in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe's ventral surface.
